name: member.savings_balance.read
description: Signs on to Meridian Core, looks up a member by member number, and returns the current balance of their savings share account. Read-only: navigates and reads, commits nothing.

memberId.description: The member number to look up.

savingsBalance.description: The current balance of the member's Savings account.

outcomes.description: The member with the specified ID does not exist.
The user does not have permission to view the member's details.
The signed-on operator is not authorized to view this record. A legitimate answer to the caller's question, not a malfunction — the record exists and access was refused.
No record matched the identifier supplied. The caller asked about something that does not exist; this is information, not an error.
